submitted.rationale: XRD at indices 3, 9, 14 and 22 showed a single rutile-type (FeSbO4-like) phase from 18% to 48% Sb. At 73% Sb there were extra peaks, likely from a secondary Sb oxide. EQE rose steeply toward the Fe-rich end: 0.0034% at Fe0.52 (index 14), 0.071% at Fe0.72 (index 7) and 0.467% at Fe0.84 (index 2). Index 2 is the best measured composition.
